method: Manual transcription of explicitly reported times and approximate speed bounds; original primary URLs and section/caption labels retained. Not a digitized position/time series or an instrument reduction.
cautions: Neuquen and Rio Negro composites are approximately 13 minutes apart. K-Cor starts later at17:56UTC; no same-epoch cross-calibration is assumed.
HAO reports four CMEs during its observing period. Association of those structures with the earlier eclipse components is unresolved.
Published POS ranges are approximate bounds, not individual samples with statistical errors; they are ineligible for quantitative scoring.
No artificial shock coordinates, density values, 3D velocity, uncertainty or acceptance tolerance was created.

official_radial_pb.uncertainty: The published standard deviation describes variation around the solar azimuth. It is not a measurement-error covariance or standard error; no error bar is invented.
